upstream.source_data: Stage 01 clean samples & Stage 02 statistical distribution findings.
upstream.inherited_features: Raw high-cardinality strings and raw YYMMDDHH timestamp format.
upstream.inherited_hypotheses: Linear numerical models require continuous cyclical representations of time and frequency-based density signals for high-cardinality categories.

mathematical_transition.theoretical_motivation: Integer hour representation (0-23) introduces artificial discontinuity between 23:00 and 00:00. Harmonic trigonometric projections map time onto a continuous unit circle. High-cardinality strings are mapped to frequency density rank.
mathematical_transition.complexity: Time: \mathcal{O}(N \log N) \text{ for frequency sorting; Space: } \mathcal{O}(N \times 23)

downstream.hand_off_contract: Outputs the master processed matrix X in R^{N x 23} with zero NaNs and standardized column naming.

adtech_role.business_impact: Sub-millisecond feature extraction transforms incoming OpenRTB auction JSON payloads into dense numeric vectors for downstream model inference.
